finding: Death records an evidence-scoped prior equipment slot and explicit resurrection restoration can atomically return eligible items to that slot while ordinary restoration remains carried and unequipped.
supporting_evidence: Runtime item instances already persist equipment-slot state.
Death transfer previously cleared equipment state before corpse placement.
The explicit restoreEquipment argument keeps unknown Classic restoration behavior inactive by default.
Existing Equip validation remains authoritative for slot legality, requirements, conflicts, handedness, and broken-state rejection.
assumptions: Character lifecycle orchestration supplies the authoritative character record when equipment restoration is requested.
safe_fallback: RestoreCorpseItems and the existing three-argument resurrection method restore items carried and unequipped, then remove temporary death-slot metadata.
runtime_impact: Adds optional resurrection equipment restoration using the same validated Equip transition and atomic corpse-restoration boundary.
character_save_impact: Restored equipment persists through the existing item-instance equipment slot and location fields.
world_state_impact: Corpse-held item roots leave corpse state and may enter equipment state only after all ordinary equip validation succeeds.
tests: death records the prior equipment slot
default restoration remains carried and unequipped
explicit restoration returns the item to its prior slot
missing character state rejects and rolls back the entire restoration
